roadmap.title: Four catalogue deaths
roadmap.description: Progress through Catalogues 1-4 and lose each Final Chance in sequence. Take a loan, trash one jackpot, and collect the natural jackpot and prize-multiplier achievements while scaling.

roadmap.title: Permanent tools and automation
roadmap.description: Use JP to establish the automation gadgets, Spell Book, Egg Timer, Night Market, and Machine. Build enough income for idle production while letting Mundo chase its jackpot.

roadmap.title: Restriction and catalogue cleanup
roadmap.description: Respec for the plate and Mundo failures, then complete the first-ticket, Day Job, full-catalogue, and skipped-catalogue challenge runs with the exact restrictions preserved.

roadmap.title: Endings and final grind
roadmap.description: Win Final Chance for the normal and corporation endings, complete a sub-30-minute post-prestige run, buy the remaining cosmetics and prestige upgrades, then collect the all-achievements reward.

achievements.description: Take a loan
achievements.sortReason: Trigger the loan during an early negative-balance run.
achievements.summary: Reduce the cash balance below @item{$0}, answer the ringing phone, and accept the offered loan.

guide.context: The debt does not need to be repaid. Apple Tree unlocks at level 3 and provides a quick way to create a negative balance by collecting worms.

steps.text: Reach level 3, open @item{Apple Tree}, and collect its worms until the displayed cash balance falls below @item{$0}.
Answer the phone when it rings, then accept or sign the loan offer to receive the achievement.

achievements.description: Win a super jackpot
achievements.sortReason: Occurs naturally while collecting jackpots.
achievements.summary: Keep scratching and collecting ordinary jackpots until one upgrades into a @mechanic{Super Jackpot}.

guide.context: Super Jackpots are a random follow-up to normal jackpots rather than a separate ticket. Final Chance attempts improve later ordinary-ticket odds, but no guaranteed trigger exists.

steps.text: Run the highest-volume ticket setup available and collect every ordinary jackpot.
Continue until the result is explicitly labeled @mechanic{Super Jackpot}, then collect that prize.

achievements.description: Crack 2 plates in a row
achievements.sortReason: Respec Soft Hands before the dedicated Day Job attempt.
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Day Job} with @item{Soft Hands} disabled and crack two plates consecutively.

guide.context: Soft Hands can reduce the plate-break chance to zero, so an endgame build may need a free prestige-tree respec before this attempt.

steps.text: Open the Prestige tree, respec if needed, and leave @item{Soft Hands} unpurchased for the next run.
Open @mechanic{Day Job} and keep washing plates until two consecutive plates crack without a successful plate between them.

achievements.description: Get a jackpot on the first ticket you scratch
achievements.sortReason: Use the automation-only luck setup after its required perks are owned.
achievements.summary: In a fresh run, let Scratch Bot and Mundo raise @mechanic{Scratch Luck} to level 3 through Day Job, then personally scratch one @item{Two Win} as the first catalogue ticket and hit its jackpot.

guide.context: The first-ticket state is fragile: personally washing a plate or scratching a Day Job Super Jackpot may consume it. Automated dishwashing avoids both risks while building money for luck upgrades.

steps.text: Before the attempt, own @item{Starter Kit}, @item{Pet Lover}, and @item{Dishwasher} so Scratch Bot and Mundo can handle Day Job plates.
Begin a fresh run through Prestige, a Final Chance death, or @mechanic{Abandon Run}; do not personally scratch any plate or ticket.
Let Scratch Bot and Mundo wash Day Job plates, skip every Day Job Super Jackpot ticket, and spend the income to raise @mechanic{Scratch Luck} to level 3.
Buy exactly one @item{Two Win} as the first catalogue ticket, scratch it personally, and require the normal jackpot result.
If Two Win does not jackpot or the achievement fails to register, abandon the run and repeat the clean setup.

achievements.description: Trash a Jackpot ticket
achievements.sortReason: Discard an early cheap jackpot before automation complicates control.
achievements.summary: Scratch a regular ticket until it becomes a @mechanic{Jackpot} ticket, then place that winning ticket in the trash instead of collecting it.

guide.context: Use a cheap early ticket so discarding the payout does not disrupt the run. Current builds can miss the trigger, so another clearly labeled jackpot may be required.

steps.text: Buy and scratch inexpensive regular tickets until one result is explicitly labeled @mechanic{Jackpot}.
Before collecting the payout, drag or send that Jackpot ticket to the trash can.
If the achievement does not appear, repeat with a newly scratched Jackpot ticket rather than a normal blue-sparkle result.

achievements.description: Reach the ending in 30 min or less after prestige
achievements.sortReason: Attempt after the automation and payout tree is mature.
achievements.summary: After prestiging, reach a winning @item{Final Chance} and complete the @mechanic{Claim} ending within 30 minutes of the new run.

guide.context: The normal Claim ending is faster than the corporation wait. This is best attempted after permanent automation and payout upgrades are mature, but current builds have failed-credit reports even below 30 minutes.

steps.text: Start with Scratch Bot and Mundo unlocked, then activate Egg Timer, Fan, and Subscription Bot. Prioritize Recycling, Picky Eater, Electric Fan, and Booster Kit; add Built Different, Learn by Doing, Ignorance is Bliss, Self Made Millionaire, Experienced, Smart Investment, Collector, and Big Winner for scaling.
Prestige to begin the timed run, keep the best current ticket in Scratch Bot, maximize Scratch Luck as each tier opens, and keep Egg Timer active.
Reach The Machine and build roughly @item{200 souls} for repeated Final Chance attempts without losing the run.
Win Final Chance and select @mechanic{Claim} before 30 minutes have elapsed from the post-Prestige start.
If a clearly sub-30-minute Claim ending does not register, repeat the route on another Prestige run; no reliable in-run repair is documented.

achievements.description: Die
achievements.sortReason: The first Final Chance loss ends Catalogue 1.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Catalogue 1}, buy its @item{$50M Final Chance}, and scratch that Final Chance to lose the first run.

guide.context: A Final Chance loss is intended progression: it records a death, restarts the economy, and opens the next catalogue tier for later runs.

steps.text: Scratch through Catalogue 1 until its @item{Final Chance} becomes available, then accumulate @item{$50M} and buy it.
Scratch Final Chance and allow its losing result to end the run and award the first-death achievement.

achievements.description: Die twice
achievements.sortReason: The second Final Chance loss ends Catalogue 2.
achievements.summary: On the second progression run, complete @loc{Catalogue 2}, buy its @item{$5T Final Chance}, and scratch it to die a second time.

guide.context: The second death requires the Catalogue 2 Final Chance; repeating the earlier catalogue does not replace that progression step.

steps.text: Progress through Catalogue 2, accumulate @item{$5T}, and buy its Final Chance ticket.
Scratch that Final Chance and let the losing result end the run and register death two.

achievements.description: Die three times
achievements.sortReason: The third Final Chance loss ends Catalogue 3.
achievements.summary: On the third progression run, complete @loc{Catalogue 3}, buy its @item{$200Qi Final Chance}, and scratch it to die a third time.

guide.context: Catalogue deaths are cumulative across runs and unlock the later Machine/endgame systems after the fourth loss.

steps.text: Progress through Catalogue 3, accumulate @item{$200Qi}, and buy its Final Chance ticket.
Scratch that Final Chance and let the losing result end the run and register death three.

achievements.description: Die four times
achievements.sortReason: The fourth Final Chance loss ends Catalogue 4.
achievements.summary: On the fourth progression run, complete @loc{Catalogue 4}, buy its @item{$1N Final Chance}, and scratch it to die a fourth time.

guide.context: This fourth loss finishes the forced-death sequence and unlocks The Machine, which supplies extra Final Chance attempts for a winning run.

steps.text: Progress through Catalogue 4, accumulate @item{$1N}, and buy its Final Chance ticket.
Scratch that Final Chance and let the losing result end the run and register death four.

achievements.description: Scratch final chance without dying
achievements.sortReason: Use Machine souls to win Final Chance after four deaths.
achievements.summary: After four deaths, use artificial souls for repeated @item{Final Chance} attempts, win the ticket, and select @mechanic{Claim}.

guide.context: Each artificial soul funds another endgame attempt without ending the run. The outcome is still random; 50-100 souls is a starting reserve rather than a guaranteed requirement.

steps.text: Buy @item{The Machine}, select @mechanic{Feed Money} until it creates souls, and prepare roughly @item{50-100 souls} as a starting reserve before the first winning attempt.
Reach Final Chance and keep scratching it, spending souls on retries whenever the result loses, until the ticket wins.
On the winning result, select @mechanic{Claim} and let the normal ending begin.

achievements.description: Have mundo bankrupt you
achievements.sortReason: Respec Picky Eater and deliberately feed Mundo losing tickets.
achievements.summary: With Mundo active and @item{Picky Eater} disabled, feed Mundo losing tickets until Mundo pushes the cash balance below @item{$0}.

guide.context: Picky Eater or another auto-trash effect can discard negative tickets before Mundo collects them, preventing the required bankruptcy.

steps.text: Respec the Prestige tree if needed, activate Mundo through @item{Pet Lover}, and leave @item{Picky Eater} or auto-trash disabled.
Queue many @item{Apple Tree}, @item{Scratch My Back}, or @item{Berry Picking} tickets because their negative symbols create frequent losses.
Allow Mundo to collect the losing results until the balance drops below @item{$0} because of Mundo's collection.

achievements.description: Have mundo scratch a super jackpot
achievements.sortReason: Leave Mundo active during a high-volume automated run.
achievements.summary: Keep Mundo collecting Scratch Bot results until Mundo scratches and collects a @mechanic{Super Jackpot}.

guide.context: This is a random automation trigger. The Vault is a recommended late-game ticket because a fast, sustained Scratch Bot queue produces many attempts.

steps.text: Start a run with Scratch Bot and Mundo active, then fill Scratch Bot with the best high-volume ticket available.
Keep the bot running and let Mundo collect every result until Mundo receives a result explicitly labeled @mechanic{Super Jackpot}.

achievements.description: Win a jackpot on Day Job
achievements.sortReason: Fine Dining enables the required Day Job jackpot.
achievements.summary: Buy @item{Fine Dining}, then wash @mechanic{Day Job} plates until one produces and collects a jackpot.

guide.context: Day Job cannot roll jackpots before Fine Dining is active. Its prerequisite path is Starter Kit, Completionist, and Dishwasher.

steps.text: In Prestige, buy @item{Starter Kit}, @item{Completionist}, and @item{Dishwasher}, then purchase @item{Fine Dining} for the next run.
Open @mechanic{Day Job}, wash plates until a jackpot result appears, and collect that jackpot.

achievements.description: Have all different tickets from all 4 catalogues on the table at once
achievements.sortReason: Use an endgame run with all four catalogues unlocked.
achievements.summary: Unlock all four catalogues, buy one of every distinct regular ticket from all four, and keep every purchased ticket unscratched on the table simultaneously.

guide.context: The table state is checked at once, so scratching, selling, or trashing any required ticket removes that ticket type from the set.

steps.text: Progress until @loc{Catalogues 1, 2, 3, and 4} are all available in one run.
Open each catalogue in turn, buy one copy of every distinct regular ticket, and leave each copy unscratched on the table.
After the last missing ticket type is placed, keep the entire set on the table until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Win a jackpot on all tickets from all 4 catalogues
achievements.sortReason: Sweep each ticket type and Day Job with endgame luck.
achievements.summary: Win and collect a jackpot on every regular ticket type in all four catalogues and on @mechanic{Day Job}; Final Chance tickets do not count.

guide.context: The game tracks jackpot credit by ticket type across the run. Endgame Scratch Luck and automation reduce retries, but current builds can fail to register a completed set.

steps.text: Activate @item{Fine Dining} so Day Job can roll a jackpot, then win and collect one Day Job jackpot.
For every regular ticket in Catalogues 1-4, keep buying and scratching that exact type until its jackpot is collected before moving to the next type.
Do not count any Final Chance result toward the checklist; only the regular catalogue tickets and Day Job qualify.
If the achievement does not register after the full sweep, repeat the ticket types whose jackpot credit is uncertain.

achievements.description: Scratch final chance with a catalogue still on the table
achievements.sortReason: Skip Catalogue 1 with the developed Day Job route.
achievements.summary: Leave @loc{Catalogue 1} unused on the table, earn @item{$50M} through Day Job, then scratch Final Chance while Catalogue 1 is still present and untouched.

guide.context: Progression is based on money earned, so a developed Day Job can bypass Catalogue 1 entirely. Keeping the catalogue object visible proves it was skipped.

steps.text: Start a run, move the Catalogue 1 object to a corner of the table, and do not open or scratch any of its tickets.
Use only @mechanic{Day Job} until the run reaches @item{$50M}, including the @item{$20M} progression requirement and enough to buy @item{Sand Dollar}.
Continue into the later ticket tier without using Catalogue 1; use Subscription Bot for later purchases if table space is needed.
Buy and scratch Final Chance while the unused Catalogue 1 object remains on the table.

achievements.description: Buy something more expensive than the global economy
achievements.sortReason: Catalogue 3 provides the first documented qualifying purchase.
achievements.summary: Unlock @loc{Catalogue 3} and buy @item{Xmas Countdown} for @item{$10Qa}.

guide.context: Xmas Countdown is the first documented purchase whose listed price exceeds the achievement's global-economy threshold.

steps.text: Progress through the earlier Final Chance runs until Catalogue 3 is available.
Accumulate @item{$10Qa}, open Catalogue 3, and purchase @item{Xmas Countdown}.

achievements.description: Make 1Sx while idle for at least 5 min
achievements.sortReason: Attempt once automation earns at least $1Sx unattended.
achievements.summary: Earn at least @item{$1Sx} through automation while providing no manual input for five continuous minutes.

guide.context: The inactivity window should begin only after the automated queue is already capable of sextillion-scale income; otherwise five idle minutes can finish below the threshold.

steps.text: Turn on Fan and Subscription Bot alongside Scratch Bot and Mundo, then queue @item{Berry Picking} or a ticket from Catalogue 3 or later.
Keep upgrading the automated setup until it can generate at least @item{$1Sx} without manual collection.
Leave the game running and provide no input for at least five continuous minutes while automation earns the required amount.

achievements.description: Win a prize that is 1000 times larger than the ticket cost
achievements.sortReason: Prize scaling begins during catalogue progression.
achievements.summary: Win one prize worth at least 1,000 times its ticket cost, such as @item{$10,000} from the @item{$10 Two Win} ticket.

guide.context: Two Win reaches its Scratch Luck cap at level 3. Permanent payout upgrades increase jackpot value without changing the inexpensive $10 denominator.

steps.text: Raise @mechanic{Scratch Luck} to level 3 and buy useful Prestige payout upgrades.
Scratch @item{Two Win} until one result pays at least @item{$10,000}, then collect that prize.

achievements.description: Win a prize that is 10.000 times larger than the ticket cost
achievements.sortReason: Continue the same Two Win payout setup.
achievements.summary: Win one prize worth at least 10,000 times its ticket cost, such as @item{$100,000} from the @item{$10 Two Win} ticket.

guide.context: The same low-cost Two Win setup used for Lucky ticket remains efficient; only the required payout multiplier increases.

steps.text: Keep @mechanic{Scratch Luck} at level 3 and add Prestige payout upgrades until Two Win jackpots can reach @item{$100,000}.
Scratch @item{Two Win} until one prize is at least @item{$100,000}, then collect it.

achievements.description: Win a prize that is 100.000 times larger than the ticket cost
achievements.sortReason: Requires the largest prize multiplier.
achievements.summary: Win one prize worth at least 100,000 times its ticket cost, such as @item{$1,000,000} from the @item{$10 Two Win} ticket.

guide.context: Valve's requirement is 100,000x. Late Prestige payout upgrades are needed, and current builds have occasional failed-credit reports.

steps.text: Use level 3 @mechanic{Scratch Luck} and late Prestige payout upgrades until Two Win jackpots can reach @item{$1,000,000}.
Scratch @item{Two Win}, collect a prize of at least @item{$1,000,000}, and check for the achievement.
If a qualifying payout does not register, obtain and collect another prize at or above the same threshold.

achievements.description: Have a stack of 100 or more scratched tickets in Scratch Bot
achievements.sortReason: Let Scratch Bot hold a 100-ticket stack before Mundo collects it.
achievements.summary: Let @mechanic{Scratch Bot} hold a stack of at least 100 scratched tickets before Mundo or the player collects the stack.

guide.context: Mundo normally empties completed tickets from Scratch Bot, so disabling Mundo preserves the growing stack for the counter.

steps.text: Buy the Scratch Bot Prestige unlock for @item{1 JP} and start a run with Scratch Bot available.
Turn Mundo off and do not manually collect Scratch Bot's completed stack.
Keep supplying tickets until the stack counter reaches at least @item{100 scratched tickets}.

achievements.description: Start with all automation gadgets unlocked
achievements.sortReason: Start a run after buying every start-unlocked gadget perk.
achievements.summary: Buy every start-unlocked automation perk, then begin a run with Egg Timer, Fan, Mundo, Scratch Bot, and Subscription Bot already available.

guide.context: The required prestige path costs 484 JP in the post-patch guide and is checked when a new run initializes, not when the final perk is bought mid-run.

steps.text: Activate @item{Starter Kit}, @item{Pet Lover}, @item{Air Condition}, @item{Fully Automated}, and @item{Timer Travel} in the Prestige tree.
Prestige or finish the current run, then begin the next run and confirm that all five automation gadgets are present immediately.

achievements.description: Buy all prestige upgrades
achievements.sortReason: Spend the final cleanup runs farming JP.
achievements.summary: Spend @item{28,450 JP} to purchase every upgrade in the Prestige menu.

guide.context: This is the main completion grind. Later runs yield the most JP when Catalogue 3 and 4 Super Jackpots are collected before prestiging.

steps.text: Repeat late-game runs, collect Catalogue 3 and 4 jackpots and Super Jackpots, then Prestige to bank their JP.
Purchase every remaining node in every Prestige branch until no upgrade is unowned and the total spend reaches the full tree cost.

achievements.description: Buy and equip a cosmetic
achievements.sortReason: Unlock the shop and equip its first cosmetic.
achievements.summary: Buy the @item{Night Market} prestige unlock for @item{10 JP}, purchase one cosmetic with achievement tokens, and equip it.

guide.context: The Night Market tab appears beside Prestige in the following run. Tokens come from claimed achievement badges rather than cash or JP.

steps.text: Spend @item{10 JP} on the Night Market prestige upgrade and start the next run.
Open @mechanic{Night Market}, spend achievement tokens on any cosmetic, then select that cosmetic and equip it.

achievements.description: Buy all cosmetics
achievements.sortReason: Buy every post-Patch 1.1 base-game cosmetic.
achievements.summary: Buy @item{Badge Collection} for @item{$50M}, claim achievement tokens, and purchase every base-game cosmetic in the post-Patch 1.1 Night Market.

guide.context: Patch 1.1 added 12 cosmetics to the required base-game shop set. Supporter Pack cosmetics are DLC and do not count toward this achievement.

steps.text: Accumulate @item{$50M}, purchase @item{Badge Collection}, and claim every earned achievement badge to receive its tokens.
Open Night Market and purchase every unowned base-game cosmetic, including the 12 items added in Patch 1.1.
Do not include Supporter Pack cosmetics when checking the remaining list.

achievements.description: Have $2000 without buying a scratch-off
achievements.sortReason: Begin the no-scratch-off Day Job run at $0.
achievements.summary: In a fresh run, buy and scratch no scratch-offs, then earn and hold @item{$2,000} using only @mechanic{Day Job}.

guide.context: Prestige perks do not violate the restriction. Fine Dining and PlateMaster5000 accelerate progression, while Clean Freak and Soft Hands improve plate work.

steps.text: Begin a fresh run and leave every catalogue and scratch-off unpurchased.
Wash, sell, and collect only Day Job plates until the displayed balance reaches @item{$2,000}.

achievements.description: Have $20M without buying a scratch-off
achievements.sortReason: Continue the same restricted Day Job run to $20M.
achievements.summary: In one fresh run, buy and scratch no scratch-offs, then earn and hold @item{$20M} using only @mechanic{Day Job}.

guide.context: The complete 1,823-JP Day Job build combines Fine Dining with PlateMaster5000, Clean Freak, and Soft Hands to reduce the late scaling time.

steps.text: Before starting, activate @item{Fine Dining} and @item{PlateMaster5000}, then add @item{Clean Freak} and @item{Soft Hands} in the Prestige tree.
Begin the run and do not buy, scratch, or collect any catalogue scratch-off.
Use only Day Job, reinvesting its output to level the activity, until the held balance reaches @item{$20M}.

achievements.description: Create an artificial soul
achievements.sortReason: The Machine becomes available after the four death runs.
achievements.summary: After four Final Chance deaths, buy @item{The Machine}, select @mechanic{Feed Money}, and fill the meter to create one artificial soul.

guide.context: Artificial souls are consumable retries for the final winning run, so this first creation also establishes the endgame recovery mechanic.

steps.text: Complete the fourth Final Chance death, then buy @item{The Machine} when it becomes available.
Open The Machine and repeatedly select @mechanic{Feed Money} until the soul meter fills and the first artificial soul is created.

achievements.description: Use magic to scratch a ticket
achievements.sortReason: Use the Spell Book after unlocking Tool Belt.
achievements.summary: Buy @item{Spell Book} for @item{35 JP}, then select Spell Book on a scratch-off and use its magic to scratch that ticket.

guide.context: Spell Book sits behind Tool Belt and Ignorance is Bliss in the Prestige tree, so both prerequisite nodes must be active for the run.

steps.text: Buy @item{Tool Belt} and @item{Ignorance is Bliss}, then spend @item{35 JP} on @item{Spell Book} and start a run.
Place any scratch-off on the table, select Spell Book from the tool belt, and cast it on that ticket until the magical scratch completes.

achievements.description: Upgrade Egg Timer to x5 speed
achievements.sortReason: Upgrade the late Egg Timer to its x5 cap.
achievements.summary: Unlock @item{Egg Timer}, then buy all three @item{Warp Speed} upgrades until Egg Timer displays @mechanic{x5 speed}.

guide.context: Egg Timer becomes available after the Catalogue 4 progression. The three in-run Warp Speed upgrades cost $1D in total.

steps.text: Finish the Catalogue 4/Final Chance progression and start a run with @item{Egg Timer} available.
Accumulate @item{$1D} and purchase Warp Speed I, II, and III in order until Egg Timer shows @mechanic{x5 speed}.

achievements.description: Give the winning Final Chance to the corporation
achievements.sortReason: Use the alternate corporation ending on a later winning run.
achievements.summary: Win the final @item{Final Chance}, answer the corporation's call, and wait on the @mechanic{Claim} screen without claiming until the representative takes the ticket.

guide.context: The corporation ending requires real waiting time with the game focused. Arrival begins after five minutes but can take closer to ten; trashing the winning ticket can softlock the run.

steps.text: Reach the endgame on a later run, answer the corporation's phone call, and scratch Final Chance until it wins.
When @mechanic{Claim} appears, do not press it and do not move the winning Final Chance into the trash.
Keep the game focused on that screen for at least five minutes and continue waiting up to about ten minutes until the representative arrives and takes the ticket.

achievements.description: Get all achievements in the game
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks after the other 33 achievements.
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 33 Scritchy Scratchy Steam achievements so the all-achievements reward registers.

guide.context: This meta achievement depends on Steam credit for every earlier entry, including the current trigger-risk challenges, rather than the in-game badge tokens alone.

steps.text: Complete every other achievement in the guide and confirm that all 33 show as unlocked in Steam.
Return to the game after the final unlock and allow the achievement system to award @mechanic{Achievement Hunter}.
